What to Expect from Global VR Support. Global VR is taking new steps in providing quality support and services to all of our customers. Providing an Parts Catalog to our distributors is just one step in achieving this goal. Over the next few months we will be rolling out new services like a Tech Support WEB page for both customers and distributors with Game FAQ’s, Service Bulletins, and Online Documentation. Prices are subject to change at any time. Global VR reserves the right to change prices at any time. Price shown on the Parts Catalog are the last known price and do not reflect current prices for each item listed. For a current price on parts please contact Global VR Tech Support to verify the price. Global VR will send out an updated Parts Catalog 4 times a year to our distributors. Purchase Orders Global VR requires a PO with each Part Order, or Advance RMA . The PO must contain the Company address, valid PO number, Global VR part number, and Price for your order to be processed and shipped. If the wrong price is listed on the PO, Global VR will adjust the PO and fax it back to the Buyer. If you do not agree with the new price you must contact Global VR Tech Support to cancel your order. You can send payment by check, but Global VR will not ship the parts out until payment has been verified by our bank. Available Parts Global VR will keep stock on a majority of parts listed on our Parts Catalog. We can not guarantee that all parts will be available and in stock at our warehouse at the time your order is placed. If your Items are not in stock Global VR will notify you by fax or e—mail of the parts that are on Back-Order. Please keep in mind Artwork and Graphics can have a longer lead time of up to 6 weeks depending on the last purchase date by Global VR. To find out if certain parts are in stock please call Global VR Tech Support. Shipping Global VR uses FED EX and UPS shipping to deliver parts across the world. The Buyer will state what shipping method they would like to use and is responsible for all shipping charges. If the Buyer would like the parts sooner they are responsible for the difference in shipping charges. If the Buyer does not state what shipper or shipping method to use; your parts will be sent out UPS 3 Day. If your product is under warranty, Global VR will provide UPS 3 Day shipping on Advance RMA’s to deliver your parts. The shipping cutoff time for Global VR is 3PM and is determined by the FED EX and UPS pick-up time. Any orders placed after the 3PM cutoff time be shipped the following day. Omissions Global VR is working to get all product lines listed in the Parts Catalog. You will notice that some of our games are not included in the Parts Catalog. Please call Global VR Tech Support for prices and availability on parts for our Vortek Standard, Vortek Deluxe, or Interactive Light product lines. We still have parts available for these products, and these parts will be included in our next Parts Catalog. If you need to order a part that is not listed in our Parts Catalog please call Global VR Tech Support we will try and fill your needs if at all possible.
